tools.name: browse_trades
tools.description: List Tradehand's canonical UK trades. Instant quote is available before a trader is assigned.

tools.name: search_traders
tools.description: Find current public Tradehand directory listings by trade and optional UK postcode or place. Returns claim state, listing-source freshness, accreditation names, and canonical profile URLs; it does not claim availability, expose mixed-source ratings, or contact anyone.

tools.name: get_trader
tools.description: Return a public directory profile by listing slug. Instant quote remains available even when the listing has no purchasable catalogue. Does not expose phone, street address or coordinates.

tools.name: get_service_options
tools.description: Return the listing's actual catalogue services when one exists. Does not reserve a slot or claim bookability.

tools.name: get_page_markdown
tools.description: Fetch a public Tradehand website page as clean markdown for agent reading and summarisation.

tools.name: get_agent_discovery
tools.description: Return the public agent discovery endpoints, content policy, and canonical URLs for Tradehand.

tools.name: read_open_knowledge_concept
tools.description: Read one file of the Tradehand Open Knowledge Format bundle under /okf as raw markdown, YAML frontmatter intact. Start at /okf/index.md for the list of concepts.
